words.definition: The act of getting on a plane or ship.
words.example: Boarding begins at gate twelve.

words.definition: The act of leaving a place.
words.example: Our departure is at six.

words.definition: A place where people are stopped and checked.
words.example: We waited at the security checkpoint.

words.definition: A comfortable waiting room at an airport or hotel.
words.example: We waited in the lounge before boarding.

words.definition: A long strip of ground where planes take off and land.
words.example: The plane waited on the runway.

words.definition: A person who flies a plane.
words.example: The pilot said we'd land in ten minutes.

words.definition: The part of a plane for passengers, or a small wooden house.
words.example: Please stay seated in the cabin.

words.definition: A building at an airport where passengers wait.
words.example: Our flight leaves from terminal two.

words.definition: A short stop between two flights.
words.example: We had a four-hour layover in Dubai.

words.definition: A moving belt where you collect your bags at an airport.
words.example: Wait for your luggage at the carousel.

words.definition: To move your head up and down to say yes.
words.example: He nodded when I asked.

words.definition: To lift your shoulders to show you don't know or care.
words.example: She just shrugged and walked away.

words.definition: To close and open your eyes quickly.
words.example: I didn't even blink.

words.definition: To smile widely.
words.example: He grinned from ear to ear.

words.definition: To pull your eyebrows together because you are unhappy or thinking.
words.example: She frowned at the bill.

words.definition: To look at someone in an angry way.
words.example: He glared at the driver who cut him off.

words.definition: To go red in the face because you are embarrassed.
words.example: She blushed when he complimented her.

words.definition: To shake slightly because of cold or fear.
words.example: I shivered in the cold wind.

words.definition: To rub a surface to clean or dry it.
words.example: Wipe the table, please.

words.definition: To touch lightly so that someone laughs.
words.example: Stop tickling me!

words.definition: To shout loudly.
words.example: Don't yell at me!

words.definition: To ask for something in an urgent or humble way.
words.example: He begged me to forgive him.

words.definition: To talk too proudly about what you have or can do.
words.example: He's always boasting about his new car.

words.definition: To argue angrily with someone.
words.example: The brothers quarrel over everything.

words.definition: To breathe in suddenly because of surprise or pain.
words.example: Everyone gasped when the lights went out.

words.definition: To make a loud, deep sound.
words.example: The crowd roared when he scored.

words.definition: To make the sound a dog makes.
words.example: The neighbor's dog barks all night.

words.definition: To speak quietly, often because you are annoyed.
words.example: He muttered something under his breath.

words.definition: To talk angrily for a long time.
words.example: She ranted about the bad service.

words.definition: To talk quickly in a way that is hard to understand.
words.example: The baby babbled happily.

words.definition: A small furry pet with a short tail.
words.example: My hamster runs on its wheel all night.

words.definition: A small reptile with four legs and a long tail.
words.example: A lizard ran across the wall.

words.definition: An insect with a hard shell on its back.
words.example: A beetle crawled across the floor.

words.definition: A small wormlike animal that turns into a butterfly.
words.example: The caterpillar is eating a leaf.

words.definition: A jumping green insect.
words.example: A grasshopper jumped onto the path.

words.definition: A small red insect with black spots.
words.example: A ladybug landed on my hand.

words.definition: A long thin insect with large wings.
words.example: A dragonfly hovered over the pond.

words.definition: A small jumping insect that makes a chirping sound, or a bat-and-ball sport.
words.example: We heard crickets all night.

words.definition: A dark insect that lives in dirty places.
words.example: There's a cockroach in the kitchen!

words.definition: A small animal with claws and a poisonous tail.
words.example: Be careful of scorpions in the desert.

words.definition: To put equipment in place so it is ready to use.
words.example: We installed a new heater last winter.

words.definition: To repair and improve an old building.

words.definition: To remove something from a surface using something sharp.

words.definition: To make a hole with a tool.

words.definition: To cut something with a saw.

words.definition: To fix something with screws.

words.example: The horse bolted when it heard the noise.

words.definition: To open something with a key.

words.definition: To disconnect a machine from the power.

words.definition: A journey to visit several places.

words.definition: A book with information for tourists.

words.definition: A person who moves from place to place.
words.example: Nomads live in tents in the desert.

words.definition: A short vacation.
words.example: We planned a weekend getaway.

words.definition: Sad because you miss home.
words.example: I felt homesick on my first trip.

words.definition: A group of vehicles or people traveling together, or a trailer you live in.
words.example: A caravan of cars crossed the desert.

words.definition: A bag carried on the back.
words.example: He packed a rucksack.

words.definition: A path through the countryside.
words.example: We followed the trail.

words.definition: A small house or hotel in the mountains or countryside.
words.example: We stayed in a ski lodge.

words.definition: To move text up or down on a screen.

words.definition: To move your finger across a touch screen.

words.definition: To make devices or files match each other.

words.definition: To save a web page so you can find it again.

words.definition: To restart a computer.

words.definition: To remove information from a computer.
words.example: Please delete the old files.

words.definition: To put copied text into a document.

words.definition: To make an image look bigger or closer on a screen.
words.example: Zoom in so I can read the text.

words.definition: To label someone in a photo or post online.

words.definition: A long stick used for fishing.

words.definition: A device that winds the fishing line.

words.definition: Food used to catch fish.

words.definition: A person who fishes.

words.definition: A freshwater fish.

words.definition: A type of fish.

words.definition: A fish with long whiskers.

words.definition: A sea fish eaten as food.

words.definition: A small oily fish.

words.definition: Feeling shy or uncomfortable because of something awkward.

words.definition: Unhappy because someone has something you want.

words.definition: Feeling thankful for something.

words.definition: A soft seat filled with beans.

words.definition: A hanging light with many bulbs.
words.example: A crystal chandelier.

words.definition: A mat for a drink.

words.definition: A closed shelf for storage.
words.example: The plates are in the cupboard.

words.definition: A cloth for removing dust.
words.example: A feather duster.

words.definition: A tube for pouring liquid into a bottle.
words.example: Use a funnel.

words.example: A cigarette lighter.

words.definition: A small case worn on a chain.
words.example: A gold locket.

words.definition: A lock with a U-shaped bar.
words.example: Put a padlock on the gate.
